name: Prison of Eyes
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [mind-affecting]; Level mesmerist 6, legendary mesmerist 7, witch 7; Focus stare 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close
Target one creature
Duration concentration up to 3 rounds, then instantaneous (see text)
Saving Throw Will disbelief; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You trap a creature inside its own mind. From the target’s perspective, upon failing its initial saving throw, it falls into a world contained within your eyes where you reign supreme. While trapped in this illusory world, the target is stunned, and cannot perceive the real world in any way, though you can communicate with it if you choose. At the end of your turns, it may attempt another saving throw to escape. Once per round, before the target attempts this save, you may cast an enchantment, phantasm) or pattern spell with a casting time of less than 1 round inside the illusion rather than the real world. Spells cast in this way are resisted by the same Will save the creature attempts against prison of eyes and can only affect the target. On a success, the creature resists both spells. Casting prison of eyes inside a prison of eyes adds 3 rounds to the time you can spend concentrating. You may take no other actions while you concentrate, but remain aware of your surroundings, and can stop at any time. Each round you maintain the spell, an arbitrary amount of time appears to pass for the target. The illusory world appears as a vast, abstract representation of the last spell you’ve cast into it. If you have cast no additional spell, it appears as an oppressive, black void. After the spell ends, the target is disoriented from its time inside the prison, becoming dazed for the same number of rounds you’ve concentrated. The target suffers this condition even if the spell ends prematurely.
